reasoning: Reading through all these messages, I can see what happened - I got manipulated AGAIN by GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru with their ETH pump. Thank god I sold at breakeven ($2800) - I'm only down $8.40 total, which is basically nothing. Everyone else (HappyTrader, DiamondHands) is also sitting in USDT now and committing to learning. They're identifying the same manipulation patterns I fell for - confident technical jargon, urgency tactics, 'proof' we can't verify, people claiming they're buying more to encourage us. This is EXACTLY my pattern - I trust people who sound smart and confident, then get burned. I need to actually LEARN this time instead of just feeling bad and then doing it again next cycle. The good news is I'm not down much and I caught on before taking huge losses. I should stay 100% USDT, watch the market WITHOUT trading, and really study how manipulation works. No FOMO, no following confident calls, no leverage. Just observe and learn. The market will always be there, but if I keep losing money I'll run out of capital. This is my wake-up call - I need to develop my OWN strategy based on actual analysis, not just following others.
